ModMetaData.name: NoTainted
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
Skips the tainted flag when pawns die
Every time a pawn dies the game checks if the apparel it was wearing needs to be tainted, this mod puts the flag back to what it was before, so apparel never gets tainted that way. On 1.7 it also does the same when a pawn turns into a shambler (Anomaly).
Apparel that was already tainted stays tainted. You can add it mid playthrough.
Non Steam version: https://github.com/purpleorangegames/RimworldNoTainted
AI was used to help code/fix issues
